action_args.justification: The series exhibits strong trend (strength 1.0) and strong annual seasonality (period 52), with ambiguous stationarity. Model rankings are highly unstable (Kendall tau 0.033) and errors are heavily correlated (mean 0.9, only 3 independent groups), so no single model or fitted weighting can be trusted to generalize. The trimmed mean of the 5 most consistently-ranked models (ETS, THETA, FT_catboost, ONLY_FT_rf, NaiveMovingAverage) is the most robust strategy for this regime: it captures the trend and seasonality signal while the trimming guards against the one or two models that misbehave in any given window. The leader is a seeded baseline with an 'indistinguishable' verdict, confirming no tested alternative is statistically superior.
